nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    restaurants=restaurants,
    groupBy="restaurant"
)

# Save the nearest restaurants to the cache for future reference
save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants_to_hotel", value=nearest_restaurants)

# Output the query summary
print(nearest_restaurants.query_summary)
